review_notes: Video-only clean derivative of a Scientific Reports experimental supplementary movie shows dark electrodeposits initiating at opposing electrode tips, thickening, and growing into branching/fractal dendritic morphology over time. A single frame could show only electrodes or an already formed dark deposit, but the accepted concept requires observing electrode-driven growth fronts and dendritic morphology formation across the temporal sequence. The source page double-checks the experimental dendrite growth context and CC BY 4.0 license; the pass decision relies on visible growth dynamics rather than source text. Nearby modeling videos and the high-frequency wire-like experimental clip were not merged.
